status: implemented local bounded-profile composition; full product and device gates remain open

installed_policy.authority: trusted compiled native embedding, never a downloaded manifest or unsigned sidecar
installed_policy.runtime_fingerprint: exact equality with InstalledRuntime and verified artifact; optional RuntimeIdentity descriptor factory derives hash and directly represented host/VM policy together. Actual complete build input capture, signed embedding and publication remain open.
installed_policy.profile: explicit integer-v1, numeric-v2 or table-memory-v3; guest cannot select
installed_policy.startup_export: fixed nonempty UTF-8 name <=4096 bytes; no startup arguments
installed_policy.native_limits: may only narrow unchanged VM ceilings
installed_policy.capabilities: nonempty installed capability hashes or signed grants are rejected; guest capability imports are unavailable

verified_selection.provisional_and_healthy: immutable copied payload and VerifiedArtifact from the same private updater and pinned verifier
verified_selection.executable_validation: complete owned VM validation before staging and selection; no public accepting-validator hook
verified_selection.memory: effective pages = min(installed pages, floor(signed memory_bytes/65536)); this bounds linear memory, not total process RSS
verified_selection.fuel: effective minimum of installed and signed per-invocation fuel
verified_selection.remaining_resources: installed operand stack, call depth and host call bounds; frozen profile bounds apply to decoder/functions/instructions/table/locals

lifecycle.start: once per coordinator process feature session
lifecycle.download: host supplies signed offers and bounded chunks before start; high-water/replay state remains in durable updater
lifecycle.worker: synchronous native execution in detached worker; actor remains responsive to close
lifecycle.invocation_admission: one operation per coordinator at a time; overlapping work rejects
lifecycle.startup_deadline: monotonic interval includes selection, validation, construction and startup export; watchdog cooperatively cancels published native session and rejects late completion
lifecycle.preemption: validation/construction have fixed resource bounds but cannot be forcibly preempted; no hard wall-time termination guarantee
lifecycle.close: invalidate coordinator, cancel work and close native session; admitted work may finish before cancellation
lifecycle.cancellation: before publication retires subsequently created session; after completed publication a late timer cannot close it; no rollback

recovery.startup_attempts: candidate plus at most one retained healthy guest, then explicit native fallback
recovery.native_fallback: embedding launches its actual compiled implementation; coordinator does not fabricate native success
recovery.health: successful startup plus installed host-reported required milestones and durable updater monotonic observation interval
recovery.other_failures: unknown interruption; argument errors, cancellation, unsupported native float state and contained native panic never count as deterministic guest traps
recovery.post_start_failure: close guest, return error and native-fallback snapshot; do not live-switch to another guest
recovery.healthy_execution_failure: native fallback for this process; durable healthy-guest quarantine remains open
recovery.open_failure: embedding chooses native fallback without deleting replay state

unqualified: full Swift/WASI and UI guest execution
capability imports and native effect reconciliation
complete installed build identity and immutable published packaging
physical OS lifecycle, power loss and device performance
healthy-guest durable failure policy and app state migration
FieldLog adoption, hosted delivery, stores and GA
